messages.subject: Re: Question regarding uploading a pre-set data onto shiny server.
parts:
Put the CSV file in the same directory as your ui.R and server.R, and do read.csv("config.csv" ...).

Or put it in a subdirectory of your ui.R/server.R directory, and use a relative path.

(When Shiny apps are started, the working directory is always set to the application directory.)
